title: sync: alinhar cursor/v-deo-10-minutos-legenda-ed04 com main
body: ## Resumo - mescla `origin/main` nesta branch de trabalho baseada em `cursor/v-deo-10-minutos-legenda-ed04` - resolve conflitos para preservar as mudanças dos dois lados em YouTube, geração de vídeo, Facebook e UI - deixa esta branch contendo os históricos de `main` e de `cursor/v-deo-10-minutos-legenda-ed04` ## Validação - `python3 -m compileall app worker.py` - import da aplicação FastAPI com checagem das rotas `/social/publish`, `/social/status` e `/youtube/generate_video` - checagem live do OpenAPI em `http://127.0.0.1:8000/openapi.json` - checagens Git confirmando que `origin/main` e `origin/cursor/v-deo-10-minutos-legenda-ed04` são ancestrais desta branch - walkthrough manual da UI em `YouTube Auto` ## Artefatos [sync_branches_youtube_tabs_and_community.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-aae1dcfb-f420-4b16-8015-32a90f0ef147/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fsync_branches_youtube_tabs_and_community.mp4) [Abas do YouTube Auto](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-aae1dcfb-f420-4b16-8015-32a90f0ef147/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fyoutube_tabs_visible.webp) [Comunidade do YouTube Auto](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-aae1dcfb-f420-4b16-8015-32a90f0ef147/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fyoutube_tabs_and_community_final.webp) [git_sync_checks.log](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-aae1dcfb-f420-4b16-8015-32a90f0ef147/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fgit_sync_checks.log) [live_openapi_checks.log](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-aae1dcfb-f420-4b16-8015-32a90f0ef147/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Flive_openapi_checks.log) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
